subject: STRATUSBANK: AuditStream retention/export playbook and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@stratusbank.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.hsu@stratusbank.com, procurement@stratusbank.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logging & retention clarifications for RFP (follow-up)

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement RFP we've got a short set of technical clarifications from our security team focused on logging/audit trails and evidence exportability. Attached is the XLS with the questions but high level we need:

- Confirmation of what events are persisted in the AuditStream (admin actions, model loads, inference metadata, API key usage, routing/fallback events).
- Retention windows by event class and whether retention is configurable per-customer or per-environment.
- Export formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet), sampling or slicing controls, and support for time-range bulk exports.
- Chain-of-custody / tamper-evidence for delivered bundles.

For timelines: security needs an evidence package for an internal audit by 11 Aug. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a bulk export of 30 days of audit logs (timestamped, hashed) and a short runbook explaining steps to reproduce the export?

I've attached the RFP question sheet and a tiny sample of the log rows we'd like to see as a reference. Please loop in whomever owns evidence exports.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Sr. InfoSec Engineer
StratusBank
[Attachment: stratus_rfp_logging_questions.xlsx]
[Attachment: audit_log_sample_2026-06.csv]

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@stratusbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging & retention clarifications for RFP (follow-up)

Erin — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide everything you asked for. High-level answers first, then next steps below.

High-level answers:
- Events persisted: admin/admin-role changes, model deploy/rollback, inference requests (metadata only: model id, route, latency, token counts), auth events (API key creation/revocation), routing fallback events, and storage access audits. We do not persist full request bodies for hosted inference by default; payload retention is configurable for Dedicated/Private.
- Retention: default hosted retention is 90 days for detailed event rows; customers can elect 1y or custom retention for Dedicated/Private via policy. Retention is configurable per-customer via the Console (or via API for Private).
- Exports: bulk exports support newline-delimited JSON and Parquet; CSV is available for flattened event sets. Time-range exports and predicate filters supported; exports are streamed to S3 (pre-signed URL) or delivered as GPG-signed bundles.
- Tamper-evidence: bundles include a SHA-256 manifest and a signing certificate from Redwood's evidence service. We can provide a chain-of-custody report and reproducible commands to regenerate the manifest.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben (cc'd) will draft a short export playbook that walks through preparing the bundle and the CLI/API steps.
2) Laura will coordinate delivery timing and attach the evidence package to a shared Drive link encrypted for StratusBank.
3) We can snapshot a 30-day export now for your team to validate; ETA 7 business days after written go-ahead.

I'll attach a draft playbook in a follow-up. If 11 Aug is a hard deadline, let us know and we'll prioritize a snapshot as soon as we get written approval.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: auditstream-export-playbook-draft.pdf]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Audit logging & retention clarifications for RFP (follow-up)

Avery / Laura — drafting notes and a couple clarifying questions for Erin before we produce the bundle. Planning to include an example extraction and the manifest creation steps. Draft below for the Playbook intro; I'll attach a small sample export (sanitized) to the Drive link.

Playbook excerpt (draft):
1) Scope: select event classes ("admin", "auth", "inference-meta", "routing") and time window.
2) Extraction: use Redwood CLI `rwd export-logs --account <acct> --from 2026-06-01 --to 2026-06-30 --events admin,auth,inference-meta,routing --format parquet --output s3://redwood-evidence/stratus-2026-06/`
3) Manifest: compute SHA-256 for each file, include signed manifest via `rwd evidence sign-manifest --bundle <dir>`; sign using Redwood evidence signing key.
4) Delivery: create pre-signed S3 URL with 7-day expiry and deliver via encrypted Drive link.

Questions for Stratus (Erin/Tom):
- Do you require raw inference request payloads (full user inputs) or only request metadata? Processing payloads will change retention and privacy controls.
- Preferred delivery format: Parquet (columnar) or ndjson? Parquet is smaller but requires schema support.
- Need for HSM-backed timestamp attestation or is signed manifest sufficient?

I'll get a sanitized sample export to the Drive link by COB Wed (29 Jul) assuming no blockers.

—Ben
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit_log_sample_2026-06.csv (sanitized)]

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@stratusbank.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tom.hsu@stratusbank.com, procurement@stratusbank.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging & retention clarifications for RFP (follow-up)

Avery/Ben/Laura — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick answers:

- We only need request metadata (no PII or full payloads) for the audit package.
- Preferred format: Parquet for the bulk bundle and NDJSON for a quick spot-check sample.
- Signed manifest is acceptable for now; we will flag if we need HSM attestation during the legal review.
- 11 Aug audit is a firm internal deadline; please prioritize a 30-day snapshot by 6 Aug to give our auditors time to review.

Next steps: please upload the snapshot bundle to the Drive link and share an encrypted delivery note. Laura — if you can confirm the ETA and delivery link by Tue 3 Aug that would be ideal. Also, procurement will send the PO/SOW paperwork after we validate the extract.

Best regards,
Erin Walsh
Sr. InfoSec Engineer, StratusBank
[Attachment: SB_Procurement_Form_2026.pdf]
